bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity halted traffic before Diwali, and the office should monitor Metrowater's repair work.

India's data centre capacity is projected to reach 2 GW in 2026 driven by AI demand, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth opportunities.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 will take place on November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway, and the office should prepare for founder and investor engagements.
